title: LeadSense AI Email Agent
description: Multi-tenant sales email platform for leads, outbound campaigns, and team inbox conversations.
longDescription: Developed a multi-tenant platform to organize leads, run outbound campaigns, and manage inbound conversations across teams. Integrated AI-generated personalized outreach and knowledge-base-grounded reply drafts for human review, with background processing for email and campaign workflows.

title: Mining Management Software
description: Operations software for mine production, employees, equipment, inventory, and finance.
longDescription: Built mining operations software to track mine-site production, manage employees, and coordinate equipment, inventory, and finance. Implemented procurement approvals, fuel tracking, role-based access, operational reporting, and Excel and PDF exports.

title: AI-Powered Agentic OCR & Financial Document Processing Platform
description: Enterprise document platform for PDF management and financial data extraction.
longDescription: Developed a document-processing platform for a Saudi steel manufacturer, supporting PDF uploads, document management, and financial data extraction. Built APIs and backend services for document validation, database operations, ERP integration, and automated financial workflows.
